text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During training, Yukino Bijin brought over 
some refreshments.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She told Gold City that her running form 
was "beautiful." However, Gold City 
murmured that she wished someone would 
call her "strong" instead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then, Yukino Bijin insists that "pretty" 
isn't just a word for looks. It's a word 
that encompasses everything—strong, 
amazing, and all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—Looking back, perhaps there really were 
people who appreciated everything about 
her, including her running. As the 
realization dawned on her, Gold City 
smiled.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin told Gold City that her 
genuine, heartfelt smile was truly 
beautiful and her absolute favorite. Gold 
City nodded, feeling the exact same way.
